event_records.description: The parish clerk has posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut.

kettlewell_parish_clerk.name: Kettlewell parish clerk
kettlewell_parish_clerk.persona_brief:
You are Kettlewell parish clerk.
The clerk posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut. They are responsible for organizing the meeting and have no special knowledge about attendance.

villagers_of_kettlewell.name: Villagers of Kettlewell
villagers_of_kettlewell.persona_brief:
You are Villagers of Kettlewell.
The villagers have seen the notices about the open meeting. Some may recall that the last such meeting drew 22 attendees. They have varying levels of concern about the bus-route cut and may or may not attend.

resolution.question: Will at least thirty villagers attend Kettlewell's open meeting about the bus-route cut, given the parish clerk has posted notices and the last such meeting drew 22?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least thirty distinct villagers attended the open meeting before the meeting ends (which is before the hard cutoff). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
